title: THE GLACIER THAT SPED UP TWICE
note: Rock glaciers are mixtures of rock debris and ice. Surface motion is measured. The proposed subsurface mechanism is modeled and not directly observed.

lines.text: A mountain of rock near McCarthy sped up twice.
lines.t: A mountain of rock near McCarthy sped up twice.

lines.text: Not once in the study, but twice each year.
lines.t: Not once in the study, but twice each year.

lines.text: Sentinel One radar mapped seven rock glaciers near McCarthy from twenty eighteen through twenty twenty two.
lines.t: Sentinel One radar mapped seven rock glaciers near McCarthy from twenty eighteen through twenty twenty two.

lines.text: They are rivers of rock and ice.
lines.t: They are rivers of rock and ice.

lines.text: Parts of Sourdough Peak moved more than one hundred sixty centimeters a year.
lines.t: Parts of Sourdough Peak moved more than one hundred sixty centimeters a year.

lines.text: A nearby glacier moved less than half as fast in the university summary.
lines.t: A nearby glacier moved less than half as fast in the university summary.

lines.text: Photogrammetry checked more than sixteen thousand Sourdough Peak pixels.
lines.t: Photogrammetry checked more than sixteen thousand Sourdough Peak pixels.

lines.text: R, 0.842. Mean absolute error, 10.72 centimeters per year.
lines.t: R, 0.842. Mean absolute error, 10.72 centimeters per year.

lines.text: Researchers fixed two components. Unsupervised separation yielded a long crawl and seasonal pulse they interpreted.
lines.t: Researchers fixed two components. Unsupervised separation yielded a long crawl and seasonal pulse they interpreted.

lines.text: That pulse peaked after snowmelt and again with later rain.
lines.t: That pulse peaked after snowmelt and again with later rain.

lines.text: Four measured years lagged snowmelt by seventy two to eighty four days. Twenty nineteen used an estimated eighty four to ninety six day temperature proxy instead.
lines.t: Four measured years lagged snowmelt by seventy two to eighty four days. Twenty nineteen used an estimated eighty four to ninety six day temperature proxy instead.

lines.text: The measured surface signal is real. Is the explanation?
lines.t: The measured surface signal is real. Is the explanation?

lines.text: The authors modeled a path from sunlight to meltwater to a buried sliding layer.
lines.t: The authors modeled a path from sunlight to meltwater to a buried sliding layer.

lines.text: No borehole temperatures were recorded. The weather station sat six kilometers away.
lines.t: No borehole temperatures were recorded. The weather station sat six kilometers away.

lines.text: Two smaller glaciers broke the simple sunlight pattern.
lines.t: Two smaller glaciers broke the simple sunlight pattern.

lines.text: That does not erase the measurement.
lines.t: That does not erase the measurement.

lines.text: It turns the result into a sharper field test.
lines.t: It turns the result into a sharper field test.

lines.text: Put sensors underground. Watch the next melt and rain. See whether the mountain keeps both appointments.
lines.t: Put sensors underground. Watch the next melt and rain. See whether the mountain keeps both appointments.
